entries.source: A completely private yacht experience along the Alanya coastline
entries.translation: A completely private yacht experience along the Alanya coastline

entries.source: A private yacht exclusively for your family, partner or group of friends, featuring Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, sea caves, swimming bays, music, Wi-Fi, freshly prepared lunch and premium service.
entries.translation: A private yacht exclusively for your family, partner or group of friends, featuring Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach, sea caves, swimming bays, music, Wi-Fi, freshly prepared lunch and premium service.

entries.source: offers a completely private journey along the Alanya coastline. The yacht is reserved exclusively for your family, partner or group of friends, with no other guests on board.
entries.translation: offers a completely private journey along the Alanya coastline. The yacht is reserved exclusively for your family, partner or group of friends, with no other guests on board.

entries.source: During the cruise, you will sail past Alanya Castle, the historic city walls, famous sea caves, Cleopatra Beach and scenic Mediterranean bays.
entries.translation: During the cruise, you will sail past Alanya Castle, the historic city walls, famous sea caves, Cleopatra Beach and scenic Mediterranean bays.

entries.source: The experience combines coastal sightseeing with time to relax on the sun terrace or in the shaded lounge. Swimming, snorkeling and use of the SUP board are available when sea conditions and the captain permit.
entries.translation: The experience combines coastal sightseeing with time to relax on the sun terrace or in the shaded lounge. Swimming, snorkeling and use of the SUP board are available when sea conditions and the captain permit.

entries.source: The yacht has a Bluetooth audio system and Wi-Fi, allowing your group to create its own private atmosphere on board.
entries.translation: The yacht has a Bluetooth audio system and Wi-Fi, allowing your group to create its own private atmosphere on board.

entries.source: Fresh BBQ, prepared lunch, seasonal fruits and unlimited soft drinks are included. The private format is suitable for romantic cruises, birthdays, family celebrations and sunset gatherings.
entries.translation: Fresh BBQ, prepared lunch, seasonal fruits and unlimited soft drinks are included. The private format is suitable for romantic cruises, birthdays, family celebrations and sunset gatherings.

entries.source: No shared group on board — the yacht belongs only to your confirmed guests during the cruise.

entries.source: The evening departure is the strongest choice for romantic light, soft atmosphere and premium photos.

entries.source: A carefully planned four-hour private yacht cruise with coastal sightseeing, swimming, freshly prepared BBQ and premium service on board. The same program is available during the 09:00–13:00, 13:00–17:00 and 17:00–21:00 departure periods.
entries.translation: A carefully planned four-hour private yacht cruise with coastal sightseeing, swimming, freshly prepared BBQ and premium service on board. The same program is available during the 09:00–13:00, 13:00–17:00 and 17:00–21:00 departure periods.

entries.source: Comfortable transfer from your hotel or apartment to Alanya Harbour. The exact pickup time is confirmed after booking.
entries.translation: Comfortable transfer from your hotel or apartment to Alanya Harbour. The exact pickup time is confirmed after booking.

entries.source: Meet the captain and crew, board your private yacht and begin the cruise along the historic Alanya coastline.
entries.translation: Meet the captain and crew, board your private yacht and begin the cruise along the historic Alanya coastline.

entries.source: Sail past the Red Tower, historic shipyard and famous sea caves with panoramic views of Alanya Castle.
entries.translation: Sail past the Red Tower, historic shipyard and famous sea caves with panoramic views of Alanya Castle.

entries.source: Enjoy a refreshing swimming stop in clear Mediterranean water, use the snorkeling equipment or try the SUP board.
entries.translation: Enjoy a refreshing swimming stop in clear Mediterranean water, use the snorkeling equipment or try the SUP board.

entries.source: One of the crew members prepares fresh BBQ on board. Lunch, seasonal fruits and unlimited soft drinks are included.

entries.source: Connect your own music, relax on the sun terrace or in the shaded lounge and enjoy the yacht exclusively with your group.

entries.source: Which departure period is best for a sunset experience?
entries.translation: Which departure period is best for a sunset experience?

entries.source: Choose the 17:00–21:00 period when available. Sunset timing changes during the season, so the final atmosphere depends on the selected date.
entries.translation: Choose the 17:00–21:00 period when available. Sunset timing changes during the season, so the final atmosphere depends on the selected date.

entries.source: Can we use our own music on board?
entries.translation: Can we use our own music on board?

entries.source: Yes. The yacht has a Bluetooth audio system, so one guest can connect a compatible phone and manage the group’s playlist.
entries.translation: Yes. The yacht has a Bluetooth audio system, so one guest can connect a compatible phone and manage the group’s playlist.

entries.source: Can we organize a birthday or romantic surprise?
entries.translation: Can we organize a birthday or romantic surprise?

entries.source: Yes. The private format is suitable for birthdays, romantic moments and family celebrations. Share the occasion and any special setup requests before confirmation.
entries.translation: Yes. The private format is suitable for birthdays, romantic moments and family celebrations. Share the occasion and any special setup requests before confirmation.

entries.source: May we bring a cake, desserts or personal food?
entries.translation: May we bring a cake, desserts or personal food?

entries.source: Yes. Personal food, desserts or beverages may be brought for the private group. Inform the team in advance when storage, serving or special preparation may be needed.
entries.translation: Yes. Personal food, desserts or beverages may be brought for the private group. Inform the team in advance when storage, serving or special preparation may be needed.

entries.source: Yes. Swimming and SUP are optional. Guests may remain on board and use the sun terrace or shaded lounge area during water stops.
entries.translation: Yes. Swimming and SUP are optional. Guests may remain on board and use the sun terrace or shaded lounge area during water stops.

entries.source: Is internet available during the cruise?
entries.translation: Is internet available during the cruise?

entries.source: Unlimited Wi-Fi is listed as an onboard amenity, although connection quality may vary while the yacht is moving along the coast.
entries.translation: Unlimited Wi-Fi is listed as an onboard amenity, although connection quality may vary while the yacht is moving along the coast.

entries.source: How should we confirm a group larger than five guests?
entries.translation: How should we confirm a group larger than five guests?

entries.source: Send the final guest count before booking. The base charter covers up to five guests, additional guests are priced separately, and the total must remain within the yacht’s 12-person capacity.
entries.translation: Send the final guest count before booking. The base charter covers up to five guests, additional guests are priced separately, and the total must remain within the yacht’s 12-person capacity.

entries.source: Can the cruise atmosphere be adjusted for our group?
entries.translation: Can the cruise atmosphere be adjusted for our group?

entries.source: Yes. The private format allows the music, pace and general mood to be shaped around the occasion, while navigation and safety decisions remain with the captain.
entries.translation: Yes. The private format allows the music, pace and general mood to be shaped around the occasion, while navigation and safety decisions remain with the captain.

entries.source: Message us on WhatsApp and we will help you choose the best departure period, cruise format, route, menu and details for your private yacht experience.
entries.translation: Message us on WhatsApp and we will help you choose the best departure period, cruise format, route, menu and details for your private yacht experience.

entries.source: All guests must follow the captain and crew. These rules apply during boarding, movement on deck, water activities and changing sea or weather conditions.
entries.translation: All guests must follow the captain and crew. These rules apply during boarding, movement on deck, water activities and changing sea or weather conditions.

entries.source: Guests must follow all instructions during boarding, movement on deck, swimming stops, use of equipment, meal service and return to the harbour.
entries.translation: Guests must follow all instructions during boarding, movement on deck, swimming stops, use of equipment, meal service and return to the harbour.

entries.source: The permitted guest capacity must not be exceeded. Suitable life-saving equipment must remain available, and children require continuous adult supervision and appropriate lifejackets.
entries.translation: The permitted guest capacity must not be exceeded. Suitable life-saving equipment must remain available, and children require continuous adult supervision and appropriate lifejackets.

entries.source: Swimming and SUP use are allowed only with crew permission. Running, unsafe climbing, diving from unapproved areas and entering the water while the yacht is moving are prohibited.
entries.translation: Swimming and SUP use are allowed only with crew permission. Running, unsafe climbing, diving from unapproved areas and entering the water while the yacht is moving are prohibited.

entries.source: The captain may delay, shorten, reroute, reschedule or cancel the cruise when wind, waves, visibility, technical issues or port restrictions affect safe operation.
entries.translation: The captain may delay, shorten, reroute, reschedule or cancel the cruise when wind, waves, visibility, technical issues or port restrictions affect safe operation.

entries.source: The captain’s safety decision, vessel-specific briefing and onboard rules always take priority over the advertised route, swimming stops, timetable and entertainment plan.
entries.translation: The captain’s safety decision, vessel-specific briefing and onboard rules always take priority over the advertised route, swimming stops, timetable and entertainment plan.
